records.public_claim_text: This Annex is intended to identify potential uses of quality risk management principles and tools by industry and regulators.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: This Annex is intended to identify potential uses of quality risk management principles and tools by industry and regulators.

records.public_claim_text: However, the selection of particular risk management tools is completely dependent upon specific facts and circumstances.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: However, the selection of particular risk management tools is completely dependent upon specific facts and circumstances.

records.public_claim_text: Change Management/Change Control To manage changes based on knowledge and information accumulated in pharmaceutical development and during manufacturing; To evaluate the impact of the changes on the availability of the final product; To evaluate the impact on product quality of changes to the facility, equipment, material, manufacturing process or technical transfers; To determine appropriate actions preceding the implementation of a change, e.g., additional testing, (re)qualification, (re)validation or communication with regulators.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Change Management/Change Control To manage changes based on knowledge and information accumulated in pharmaceutical development and during manufacturing; To evaluate the impact of the changes on the availability of the final product; To evaluate the impact on product quality of changes to the facility, equipment, material, manufacturing process or technical transfers; To determine appropriate actions preceding the implementation of a change, e.g., additional testing, (re)qualification, (re)validation or communication with regulators.

records.public_claim_text: Hygiene Aspects in Facilities To protect the product from environmental hazards, including chemical, microbiological, and physical hazards (e.g., determining appropriate clothing and gowning, hygiene concerns); To protect the environment (e.g., personnel, potential for cross-contamination) from hazards related to the product being manufactured.

records.public_claim_text: Quality Risk Management as Part of Materials Management Assessment and Evaluation of Suppliers and Contract Manufacturers (II.5) To provide a comprehensive evaluation of suppliers and contract manufacturers (e.g., auditing, supplier quality agreements).
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Quality Risk Management as Part of Materials Management Assessment and Evaluation of Suppliers and Contract Manufacturers (II.5) To provide a comprehensive evaluation of suppliers and contract manufacturers (e.g., auditing, supplier quality agreements).

records.public_claim_text: Quality Risk Management as Part of Production Validation (II.6) To identify the scope and extent of verification, qualification, and validation activities (e.g., analytical methods, processes, equipment, and cleaning methods); To determine the extent for follow-up activities (e.g., sampling, monitoring and re-validation); To distinguish between critical and non-critical process steps to facilitate design of a validation study.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Quality Risk Management as Part of Production Validation (II.6) To identify the scope and extent of verification, qualification, and validation activities (e.g., analytical methods, processes, equipment, and cleaning methods); To determine the extent for follow-up activities (e.g., sampling, monitoring and re-validation); To distinguish between critical and non-critical process steps to facilitate design of a validation study.

records.public_claim_text: Quality Risk Management as Part of Laboratory Control and Stability Studies Out of Specification Results (II.7) To identify potential root causes and corrective actions during the investigation of out of specification results.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Quality Risk Management as Part of Laboratory Control and Stability Studies Out of Specification Results (II.7) To identify potential root causes and corrective actions during the investigation of out of specification results.

records.public_claim_text: Quality Risk Management as Part of Supply Chain Control (II.9) Regarding product availability risks related to quality/manufacturing issues, product lifecycle oversight of the supply chain includes maintaining current knowledge of quality/manufacturing hazards and prioritizing efforts to manage such risks.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Quality Risk Management as Part of Supply Chain Control (II.9) Regarding product availability risks related to quality/manufacturing issues, product lifecycle oversight of the supply chain includes maintaining current knowledge of quality/manufacturing hazards and prioritizing efforts to manage such risks.

records.public_claim_text: Manufacturing Facilities and Equipment To ensure that facility infrastructure and equipment are suitable and designed for robust manufacturing (this includes packaging and testing) (see Annex II.4); To establish facility and equipment maintenance programs that assure reliable facility and equipment performance; To ensure that the operational design of equipment is not vulnerable to human error; To obtain quality and efficiency gains through the utilization of digitalization, automation, isolation technology, and other innovations.

records.public_claim_text: Supplier Oversight and Relationships To enhance review and monitoring activities (see section III.G (2.7) of ICH Q10) when substantial variability is identified in the quality and safety of supplied materials or in the services provided.
